versions.localizedDescription:
MoviePilot Release

- Version: 1.2.3
- Build Date: 2026-08-25
- Android: Signed APK
- iOS: Unsigned IPA

iOS 安装说明：
- IPA 为未签名包
- 请使用自己的 Apple Developer 账号通过 AltStore、Sideloadly 或 Xcode 进行签名安装


## What's Changed
* fix: 兼容 MoviePilot v3 媒体身份契约，修复 v3 服务端下详情页 422 by @sokouu87 in https://github.com/singleton-altman/MoviePilotLite/pull/97
* fix: 适配 MoviePilot v3 的统一响应 envelope（仪表盘数值为 0 / 详情页仍 422） by @sokouu87 in https://github.com/singleton-altman/MoviePilotLite/pull/98
